verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a locally installed simulator that also ties into hosted Gazebo Fuel model servers, so asking about data residency is a fair question. However, the evidence documents no region or residency selection. Running simulations on remote servers via Gazebo Transport is a user-side deployment choice, not a residency control the product provides, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
